newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Millennium buy initiated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Millennium buy initiated.

text.p: -- Paine Webber analyst Paul Raman said he had initiated coverage of Millennium Chemicals Inc with a buy rating.
-- "It's a play on the return of product pricing," Raman said.
-- Operating rates were "very high" in all of the company's product lines, particularly polyethelyne and titanium dioxide, he said.
-- Raman estimated a share target price of $40 within 12-15 months, earnings per share of $1.50 in 1996, $2.50 in 1997.
